```{r}

readAirr <- function(sample_dir){
  df <- read.table(sample_dir, sep = '\t', header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(v_region_sequence = stringr::str_sub(toupper(sequence),
                                      start = as.integer(v_sequence_start), end = as.integer(v_sequence_end))) %>%
                               filter(!is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus & !grepl("TTTTTTTTTTT", umi) & !grepl("N", junction)) %>%
                               filter(!grepl("N", v_region_sequence))
    #filter(!is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus & !grepl("TTTTTTTTTTT", umi) & !grepl("N", junction))
  
  return(df)
}
```

figure function
```{r}
plot_knee <- function(df_airr, sample_label, chain_cols) {

  keep_loci <- c("IGH","IGK","IGL","TRA","TRB")

  df <- as_tibble(df_airr) %>%
    filter(consensus_count > 0, locus %in% keep_loci) %>%
    transmute(locus  = as.character(locus),
      group  = as.character(group),
      n_orig = as.numeric(n_orig)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(n_orig))

  knee <- df %>%
    group_by(locus, group) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(n_orig), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(locus) %>%
    arrange(desc(value), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number(), n_rank = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(pct = if_else(n_rank > 1, (rank - 1) / (n_rank - 1), 0))

  counts <- df %>%
    distinct(locus, group) %>%
    count(locus, name = "n_groups") %>%
    mutate(locus = factor(locus, levels = keep_loci),
           label = paste0(as.character(locus), ": ", scales::comma(n_groups)))

  # anchor points from curve
  label_df <- knee %>%
    filter(pct >= 0.0000001, pct <= 0.02, value > 1) %>%
    group_by(locus) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = pct, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    left_join(counts, by = "locus")

  # manual stacked label positions on the right
  label_df <- label_df %>%
    arrange(desc(value)) %>%
    mutate(x_text = 0.14,
      x_seg_end = 0.13,
      y_text = c(35, 18, 9, 4.5, 2.2)[seq_len(n())])

  ggplot(knee, aes(x = pct, y = value, color = locus)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.55, alpha = 0.95) +
    scale_color_manual(values = chain_cols, breaks = keep_loci, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1), breaks = log_breaks(n = 7)) +
    scale_x_continuous(trans  = pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 1e-4),
      limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1),
      labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(x = "Spatial sequence group size rank (%)", y = "Reads per UMI-SPBC group", color = NULL) +
    annotate("label", x = 0.0001, y = 10, label = sample_label, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fill = "gray91", label.size = 0, size = 2.7) +
    geom_segment(data = label_df, aes(x = pct, xend = x_seg_end, y = value, yend = y_text), inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(data = label_df, aes(x = x_text, y = y_text, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 0, size = 2.6, color = "black") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 8, 2, 2),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
}
```

function to only extract the legend
```{r}
extract_legend <- function(p) {
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  idx <- which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(grid::zeroGrob())
  g$grobs[[idx[1]]]
}
```

```{r}
#extract legend form one plot to add it later to the combined one
p_ont_s2 <- plot_knee(bt_sp$S2_ONT_Q17$airr_df, "S2_ONT_Q17", chain_cols)
leg <- extract_legend(p_ont_s2 + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

p_ont_s2 <- p_ont_s2 + theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  plot.margin  = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 0, l = 0),
  legend.position = "none")

p_ont_s3 <- p_ont_s3 + theme(
  #axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  plot.margin  = margin(t = 0, r = 5, b = 0, l = 0),
```

add shared y-label
```{r}
panels <- plot_grid(p_ont_s2, p_ont_s3, p_ont_s4, ncol = 1, align = "v", axis = "l", rel_heights = c(1, 1, 1.1))

panels_with_ylabel <- plot_grid(
  ggdraw() + draw_label("Reads per UMI-SPBC group", angle = 90, size = 7),
  panels, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.045, 1))
```

put together final figure
```{r, fig.width=3.2, fig.height=6}

  draw_grob(leg, x = 0.55, y = 0.5, width = 0.9, height = 1, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5)
```
